title: The experience gap
detail: Employers increasingly want to hire people who already have experience, which makes it harder for newcomers to get a first foothold, even though the skills system cannot produce experienced workers overnight.

title: Management and leadership training
detail: From new supervisors to senior leaders, employers across every sector want more, and shorter, management training as apprenticeship funding rules change.

title: Digital skills and AI, everywhere
detail: Every sector reports growing demand for essential digital skills and, increasingly, AI skills, whatever level people are starting from.

title: Young people and NEETs
detail: Youth unemployment and the number of young people not in education, employment or training (NEET) are both rising, particularly in coastal and post-industrial areas, even as employers hold back from recruiting straight from school or college.

title: Foundation and entry-level roles
detail: Retail, hospitality, leisure, agriculture, construction, care and administration all offer realistic starting points for young people who get the right work-readiness support.
